name: MicroduckSimulator
description: MuJoCo Microduck simulator with bounded movement, safe stop, deterministic ball placement, and explicit left/right-foot kicks.

move.description: Move for a bounded duration. left and right are forward curves, not strafing or in-place turns. backward is declared but returns unsupported until a stable policy is available.

direction.description: One of forward, left, right, backward.

duration_s.description: Duration from 0.2 through 5.0 seconds; defaults to 2.0.

stop.description: Stop the current locomotion command safely.

kick.description: Place the simulation ball at the trained position and kick it with the requested foot.

place_ball.description: Simulation maintenance command that resets the ball position.

position.description: One of center, left_kick, right_kick, random; defaults to center.

command_timeout_s.description: Safety timeout used by the future network adapter.

action_completed.description: A movement, ball placement, or kick completed.

reason.description: Empty on success; failure reason when applicable.

action_failed.description: An action failed or is unsupported.

command_timeout.description: A network movement command expired and was stopped.
